title: Plastic Packaging Tax — mechanically recycled plastic packaging - GOV.UK

triage.reason: GOV.UK published the government response to the May 2026 consultation, confirming the intention to introduce mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging from 1 April 2030 — a concrete new policy/timetable decision for the UK Plastic Packaging Tax.

draft.summary: The government responded to its consultation on potential certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging, which received 116 responses. It intends to introduce mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging from 1 April 2030, and will review certification and market readiness closer to implementation.
draft.source_quote: The consultation received 116 responses from businesses, trade bodies and other stakeholders. A full summary of responses and the government response is available here. Having considered the consultation responses, the government intends to introduce mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging from 1 April 2030.

key_dates.text: Intended start date for mandatory certification for mechanically recycled plastic packaging.

draft.interpretation: Businesses relying on mechanically recycled content may need to evidence their claims through a certification scheme from 2030, which could add compliance and audit costs but also support credible recycled-content claims.
